title: Retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook 2-1/2-Inch pull-out solid brass Carolina collection Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with a retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook that pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space and pushes back in when not needed. Designed to coordinate with the Carolina collection for a refined, traditional look.

Highlights:
- Retractable rod provides 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then slides back out of the way
- Solid brass construction for an enduring, classic hardware feel
- Wall mount design helps keep essentials within reach while saving floor space
- Supports up to 15 lb for coats, robes, or towels
- Optional knob tip swap: remove the supplied tip and replace with your own cabinet knob to match existing room hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Overall size: 3.75-inch W x 1.75-inch H x 1.75-inch L; 1-inch projection when retracted
- Fits standard interior walls
- Requires drilling a 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)
- Assembly required: no

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
